subject: Concierge evening demo — thin-slice roster & timezone coverage
messages:
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Concierge evening demo — thin-slice roster & timezone coverage

Team,

We're lining up a multi-prospect evening concierge demo next week (targets: Lumen Health, StellarDev, and Stratus partners). Goal: deliver a tight 45-minute thin-slice demo + 15-min breakout Q&A for each account, optimized for APAC and US night windows.

Proposed plan (high level):
- Three 45-minute blocks between 18:30-22:00 PT (covering east coast late evening + APAC early morning).
- Assign one primary host, one engineer for live prompts, and one breakout lead per block.
- Use a single bridge with breakout rooms; record main session and share recording with attendees.

Can you each reply with: 1) which blocks you can host (1/2/3), 2) if you can staff breakout lead, and 3) any constraints on laptop/region availability? I've attached a starter roster (evening_roster.csv) and a quick poll link for attendees.

I'll consolidate and push calendar invites once we confirm coverage.

Thanks,
Chloe
Chloe Martin
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwood.com

Attachment: evening_roster.csv (CSV with tentative host assignments)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Dec 2026 11:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Concierge evening demo — thin-slice roster & timezone coverage

Chloe — thanks for pulling this together. Quick answers:
- I can host block 1 (18:30-19:15 PT) and block 3 (20:45-21:30 PT) if needed.
- Happy to be the live prompts engineer for block 3; prefer not to run breakouts two blocks in a row.
- Ben, can you take breakout lead for block 1 if Lauren covers block 2?

Couple of operational notes:
- Recommend 2 presenters on the main session (host + engineer) so we can demo switching models and show latency/cost metrics live without interrupting the narrative.
- I'll upload a minimal bridge runbook (bridge_runbook.md) with dial-in fallback and recording step-by-step.

On attendee poll: I prefer the 18:30 and 20:45 slots based on historical APAC overlap.

– Marcus
Marcus Lin
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
